description: This file defines the 'ValueRangeControl' class, which provides a UI component combining two JSpinner controls for selecting a numeric range with a specified step increment.

classes.name: ValueRangeControl
classes.description: A Java class that provides a UI control consisting of two spinners for selecting a numeric value range with a specified step size.

methods.name: ValueRangeControl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the control with a title, minimum, maximum, and increment.

methods.name: getFrom
methods.description: Returns the current minimum value selected by the control.

methods.name: getTo
methods.description: Returns the current maximum value selected by the control.

methods.name: getStep
methods.description: Returns the step increment used in the spinners.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the main panel component containing the range selectors.
